name: Project users and invitations
summary: Inviting people to a project (one at a time or in bulk), managing pending invitations, and the project users list.

actions.action: Invite or assign a user to the project
Remove a user from the project

nfr.statement: Largest bulk invitation (rows per CSV) that must succeed.
nfr.open_question: How many users do customers invite at once, and is a partial-success report acceptable?

requirements.title: Invite people to a project by email
requirements.statement: A user with permission to assign project users can invite someone by email. If the invitee has no account, the invitation is applied once they register and verify (USER-REQ-003).

sources.title: Prior PRD - Roles and permissions (t3d-prd-agent prd-tech-docs)

acceptance_criteria.given: A user with assign-project-user on the Users page
acceptance_criteria.when: They enter a valid email and select Invite
acceptance_criteria.then: The invitee receives an invitation email

requirements.title: Bulk invitations from a CSV file
requirements.statement: Users can invite many people at once by uploading a CSV. Every valid row is invited and the result is logged.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Roles and permissions (t3d-prd-agent prd-tech-docs)
Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

acceptance_criteria.given: A CSV with five valid rows and one invalid email
acceptance_criteria.then: The five valid users are invited, and the invalid row is reported

requirements.title: Search and filter project users
requirements.statement: The Users page lets people search by name or email and filter by project, group and job title.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Roles and permissions (t3d-prd-agent prd-tech-docs)

acceptance_criteria.given: A user on the Users page
acceptance_criteria.when: They type part of a name or email
acceptance_criteria.then: Matching users are shown as they type

acceptance_criteria.given: A user on the Users page
acceptance_criteria.when: They filter by group and job title
acceptance_criteria.then: Only users matching both filters are shown

requirements.title: Unverified users are labelled
requirements.statement: Users who haven't verified their email appear with an "(unverified)" tag beside their name.

sources.title: Prior PRD - User management / user profile (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

acceptance_criteria.given: A project member who hasn't verified their email

requirements.title: User counts include verified and unverified active users
requirements.statement: User counts on the project card and the Manage Users page count active users, both verified and unverified. Today the code counts active users with a direct or group role on the project, and keeps a separate count without support users.

sources.title: Prior PRD - User management / user profile (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

open_checks: Users with no isSupportUser value aren't counted as non-support; counts refresh asynchronously and can be stale

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with two verified members, one unverified member and one support user
acceptance_criteria.when: A customer views the project card and the Manage Users page

requirements.title: Pending invitations can be re-roled, resent or withdrawn
requirements.statement: Before an invitation is accepted, a user with the permission can change its role, resend it or withdraw it. The web app keeps active users, pending invitations and registration status as separate lists.

sources.title: Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

acceptance_criteria.when: A user with update-project-user changes it to collaborator and resends it
acceptance_criteria.then: The invitee gets a new email, and accepting it makes them a collaborator

requirements.title: The project users list shows every role source
requirements.statement: Each row in a project's user list shows the user's direct role and the roles they get through groups, with status and activity. A single role title may not describe all of someone's access.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user who is a viewer directly and a collaborator through group G on project P
acceptance_criteria.then: Their row shows both the viewer role and the collaborator role from G

requirements.title: Add existing users to a project directly
requirements.statement: Users who already have an account can be added to a project directly, without an invitation. Trying to add someone who is already a member tells the person adding them.

acceptance_criteria.given: A registered user who isn't on project P
acceptance_criteria.when: A user with assign-project-user adds them to P
acceptance_criteria.then: They are a member immediately, with no invitation step

acceptance_criteria.given: A user who is already a member of P
acceptance_criteria.when: Someone tries to add them again
acceptance_criteria.then: The person adding them is told they're already a member

requirements.title: Reminders for unaccepted project invitations
requirements.statement: If a project invitation isn't accepted, the invitee is reminded automatically after 7, 14 and 30 days. Each reminder includes the original invitation link.
requirements.rationale: This conflicts in spirit with the 2-day default lifetime of enterprise invitations (USER-REQ-045). The two may be different invitation types; DEC-017 decides.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project invitation sent on 1 March and not accepted
acceptance_criteria.then: A reminder with the original invitation link is sent on each date
